entities.summary: Aram Avagyan is an Armenian professional boxer who held the WBC International Silver featherweight title from 2018 to 2019. As an amateur, he won bronze medals at the European championships in 2013 and 2015 as a bantamweight. He was eliminated in the second bout at the 2016 Olympics. Avagyan studied criminology at the Russian Armenian University in Yerevan.
